title: PlaceListSummary
description: A saved collection in index form (T-062) — GET /api/v1/me/lists. Metadata + item count only; the places themselves are in place-list-detail.json.

public_slug.description: Global share token — non-null once the list has been made public (T-063).

contains.description: Present only when the index was queried with ?contains={placeId}.

owner.description: Present only when the owner was eager-loaded; null when their profile is private.
